messages:
maria: Kicking off blue/green swap for router service in prod-eu. Moving v2.4.0 (green) in front of v2.3.1 (blue). Change window 01:00-01:20 UTC. Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Monitoring hooks: latency/p95, 5xx rate, error budget alarms. Preflight passed: health-checks ok, warm nodes 6/6. Release notes: https://redwood/release/rg-router-v2.4.0

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout at 01:00 UTC. run_id=roll-4832102222. See /deploys/roll-4832102222

sam: How are we handling sticky sessions? cookie affinity retention?

maria: We'll keep cookie pin (rw_sid) during shift. Router config: stickiness=Cookie, grace=30s. We'll mark old pool draining: slow drain with 60s connection drain.

jordan: Can we do a drip that caps at 60% if p95 > 180ms? suggested thresholds: p95 180ms, 5xx > 1.5% -> rollback.

maria: ack. thresholds set: p95_threshold=180ms, error_rate_threshold=1.5%. Circuit-breaker: pause shift if either exceeded for 2 consecutive windows (2x5m).

ops-oncall: Please disable autoscaler for pool-green until 15m after 100% to avoid double-warm. I'll annotate the oncall doc.

arjun: Pre-rollback checklist in case we need instant revert: 1) run `redwoodctl router set-weight --service router-eu --version v2.3.1 --weight 100` 2) drain-green 3) trigger immediate cache invalidation if routing TTL mismatch. I added scripts in infra/playbooks/quick-rollback.sh

lee: Can we prime caches before moving more than 25%? suggest synthetic requests to /health and top endpoints.

maria: good idea. will run cache-prime script at each step. steps: 5% wait 3m probe, prime; 25% wait 5m probe, prime; 60% wait 7m probe; 100% final.

deploy-bot: roll-4832102222: step1 applied -> green weight 5%. Monitoring: no anomalies after 3m.

sam: :thumbsup: watching metrics dashboard (https://dash.redwood/prod/router-eu) p95 120ms, 5xx 0.1%

jordan: reminder: keep router logs at debug for first 10m of each step, then revert to info. log-rotation set to 100MB.

maria: noted. I'll post a short release note in #eng-releases when we hit 100% and update the rollout doc.

ops-oncall: FYI I scheduled a quiet window in infra-calendar 00:50-01:30 UTC for related infra changes.

deploy-bot: roll-4832102222: step2 applied -> green weight 25%. Monitoring: p95 130ms, 5xx 0.2%.

maria: Proceeding to 60% in 5m unless any objections.

arjun: If you need instant pin back, use `redwoodctl route pin --service router-eu --version v2.3.1` (this pins while rollback runs).

sam: Quick note: session-cookie retention means some long-lived sessions can still hit blue for up to cookie TTL 12h. Noted for CS.

maria: thanks. If 5xx spike >1.5% we abort and set weight 0 for green and pin blue.

deploy-bot: roll-4832102222 completed -> green=100%. Final monitoring window 20m started.

lee: running post-roll cache-roll with low QPS synthetic.

jordan: :party_parrot: looks stable so far.
